entity_name: Gazeta Zyrtare e Republikës së Kosovës / gzk.rks-gov.net
source_name: Regjistri i Pengut (Pledge Registry, ARBK)
why_relevant: Registry of security interests: the set of secured creditors reveals which banks/MFIs/leasing companies are actively lending, an indirect indicator of lender activity and a cross-check on the licensed-institution list.

entity_name: Gazeta Zyrtare e Republikës së Kosovës / gzk.rks-gov.net
source_name: eKosova / rbk.rks-gov.net — government e-services and business registration front-end
why_relevant: The transactional layer of the business registry; confirms which registry services are digitised and is the gateway through which entity data is filed — relevant for understanding data freshness and structure of ARBK records.

source_name: EBRD Banking Environment and Performance Survey (BEPS III)
why_relevant: Survey of bank CEOs/heads of credit across EBRD regions (waves 2006, 2012, 2020-21) — supply-side strategy and lending-behaviour intelligence. Underlying microdata is NOT public due to bank confidentiality, so value is in the published research outputs.

source_name: Banka Kombëtare Tregtare (Albania) — corporate/IR pages incl. shareholders and group reporting
why_relevant: Parent bank of BKT Kosova; its consolidated reporting and governance disclosures identify the ownership chain (Çalık Holding) and occasionally consolidate Kosovo business volumes — needed to interpret Kosovo subsidiary numbers.

source_name: Sot News (sot.com.al) — Rajoni desk
why_relevant: Regional desk of an Albanian outlet carrying Kosovo payment/cash-regulation items; another mirror in the Albanian-language republication network, helpful for establishing publication timing spread.

source_name: Kosovo media coverage of CBK statistical releases (Telegrafi, Ekonomia Online)
why_relevant: Albanian-language business media reliably report CBK releases within hours, often quoting headline figures verbatim. Useful as a low-cost release-detection tripwire and for capturing CBK statements made at press conferences that never reach a PDF. Secondary reliability — always resolve back to the CBK original.

source_name: IOM Kosovo — Procurement & Tenders
why_relevant: Second donor-implementer channel in Kosovo; IOM procures cash-assistance disbursement, prepaid-card and payment-service arrangements for beneficiary programmes, which reveal card issuing/acquiring capabilities of local banks and PSPs.

source_name: Albeu.com — financial sector coverage
why_relevant: Albanian-language portal reporting on tightening cash-payment limits and the financial sector's pushback; relevant to A4 cash-usage tracking and shows industry-association reactions that rarely appear in central-bank material.

source_name: ecommerce4all-ks.com — Kosovo e-payment processing guidance portal
why_relevant: Donor/programme-built Kosovo e-commerce resource that explains, for the local market specifically, which gateways and acquirers merchants can actually use. Useful as a merchant-side map of who provides online acquiring in Kosovo and on what terms.

source_name: EMIS company profiles — Kosovo banks (ProCredit, TEB, etc.)
why_relevant: Commercial aggregator holding filed financials and company data for Kosovo banks; a paywalled fallback when a bank's own PDF archive is incomplete or a legacy year is missing.

source_name: Gazeta Bulevard (bulevardnews.com)
why_relevant: Albanian-language portal republishing Kosovo payment-regulation news with dated URLs; low editorial value but a reliable date-stamped mirror for the cash-limit story cluster.

source_name: javne-nabavke.com — Kosovo region tender aggregator (Serbian language)
why_relevant: Commercial Serbian-language aggregator covering Kosovo tenders; provides the sr-language entry point (bankomati, POS terminali, platni promet) and a rough sense of volume — its own page reports over 8,000 Kosovo tenders published in 2023 at ~EUR 448k average estimated value. Useful for cross-language keyword discovery rather than as an authoritative record.

source_name: JOQ Albania (joq-albania.com)
why_relevant: High-reach Albanian-language aggregator/portal that republishes Kosovo banking-credit stories; useful only as a reach indicator and mirror. Editorial standards are low — never use as a figure source without tracing to origin.

source_name: KOSTT — Tenders (transmission system operator)
why_relevant: Representative of the state-owned utility tier (alongside KEK/KESDS/water utilities) whose tenders cover metering, billing and customer-payment collection systems — the channel through which utility bill-payment and POS/kiosk infrastructure enters the market. Utilities are a major driver of cash-vs-card payment behaviour in Kosovo.

source_name: Poslovi Infostud — regional (sr) card/ATM banking vacancies as a comparator
why_relevant: Serbian-language banking job board carrying explicit card-and-ATM roles (e.g. 'Specijalista/kinja na poslovima upravljanja platnim karticama i monitoringom bankomata', Addiko Bank). Not Kosovo-domiciled, but it is the best sr-language comparator for role taxonomy and it may surface postings by regional groups covering Kosovo operations.

source_name: Shqiptarja.com — Kosovo economy coverage
why_relevant: Tirana-based daily that covers Kosovo payment regulation and ATK enforcement; useful as a corroboration mirror and for capturing the wording of official warnings on cash-payment limits.

source_name: Syri.net — Kosova / analiza
why_relevant: Albanian-language outlet with a Kosovo desk publishing macro-economic analysis pieces (e.g. on early elections and economic uncertainty) that contextualise banking and payment-market data. Useful for narrative and expert quotes rather than raw figures.

source_name: The Banker Database — TEB Bank Kosovo (and peer) reports
why_relevant: Normalised, comparable balance-sheet series per Kosovo bank, useful for ranking network/asset scale consistently across institutions whose own reports use different formats.

source_name: Vushtrri Online (local Kosovo news portal)
why_relevant: Example of the dense layer of Kosovo municipal/local Albanian portals that republish national banking-statistics stories; useful mainly as a mirror when a national outlet's page is down or altered, and as evidence of how widely a figure circulated.

source_name: Çalık Holding — Finance sector / BKT Kosova company page
why_relevant: Ultimate owner's portfolio page provides refreshed headline figures on BKT Kosova (branch count, client base, positioning) and confirms the ownership chain used for group-level attribution.
